title: Grilled Red Pepper Skewers with Quaint Croatian Salsa
description: A simple and flavorful dish featuring grilled red pepper skewers served with a quaint Croatian-style salsa.

ingredients.name: quaint
ingredients.notes: a small, firm variety of cheese

ingredients.name: croatian
ingredients.notes: a type of cheese or sausage, optional

instructions: Soak skewers in water for 30 minutes.
Thread red peppers, quaint cheese, and croatian cheese (if using) onto skewers.
Grill skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
Meanwhile, chop quaint cheese and mix with a pinch of salt.
Serve skewers with quaint cheese salsa.
Optional: add a dollop of Croatian-style cheese or sausage on top.
